name: last-flame
description: Last Flame: you are a flame on Diwali night. Every body you burn in dies. Leap, climb the neighbourhood, and light the temple lamp.

scripts.check: for f in server.mjs shared/*.js src/*.js test/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.package: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && zip -rq dist/last-flame-web.zip index.html src shared assets -x '*.DS_Store' && echo dist/last-flame-web.zip
